duplicates_trash_title: Move duplicate copies to the OS Trash
duplicates_scope_help: Library locations only; capture cards are never scanned. Keeps the copy in the earliest-registered location.
target_library_caption: Integration of {name} in the library, per channel
store_reason_run_name_taken: {name} is already a run in this Project
run_mode_semantics_symlink: Links to the catalogue originals. Their drive stays connected during the run.
catalogue_app_frame_desc: The app window: source list, toolbar, one scrolling content pane and the status bar. Setup uses SetupFrame.
catalogue_status_bar_desc: The bottom bar: locations, selection, running work, issue counters and notifications, each list in a ListPopover.
catalogue_palette_desc: The command palette: places, records and registered Actions in one searchable list.
catalogue_run_step_desc: A run's gate glyphs and its six steps in one line.
catalogue_walk_desc: The modal orientation walk: a cut-out around each anchor, Back, Next and Skip. A step without an anchor is passed over.
catalogue_dialogs_summary: Every dialog ends in DialogFooter: Cancel first, then the one action, on every OS. The action is primary, or red when it is destructive.
catalogue_dialogs_confirm_caption: Focus starts on Cancel when the action is destructive, else on the action. Escape cancels and focus returns to the button that opened the dialog. Tab to a group and press Enter or Space to unfold its files.
catalogue_dialogs_form_caption: Focus starts on the first field and Enter submits, unless the action is destructive. Point at or Tab to an unavailable action for its reason.
catalogue_actions_summary: One Action renders as a header button, a named menu item, a row ⋯ item, a context-menu item and a palette command, with the same label, shortcut and unavailable reason.
catalogue_actions_roles_caption: Role × size × state. Point at, Tab to or press a button for hover, focus-visible and active. Disabled stays focusable.
catalogue_actions_button_caption: The kind picks the variant. In a table cell (xs) a primary stays outline. {archive} is unavailable: point at or Tab to it for its blockers. {start} and {rescan} run slowly; {remove} is refused; the second {rescan} fails and offers {retry}.
catalogue_actions_bar_caption: Up to three standard buttons, the named menu, then the one primary at the trailing end. A fourth standard action, destructive actions and the overflow go to the menu ({more} by default, or an object menu). Feedback shows under the bar.
catalogue_actions_menu_caption: The items arrive out of order, {delete} first, with doubled separators. Every menu shows {delete} last after one separator, a heading group, a submenu, shortcuts and an unavailable item with its reason. Right-click the box for the same list as a context menu.
catalogue_actions_menu_empty: No action: the menu renders nothing
catalogue_actions_rows_caption: Each row has a ⋯ in the Tab order, and the same items on right click, Shift+F10 or the Menu key, on the row or its ⋯. One runner per list, so its feedback shows under the list.
catalogue_feedback_refusal_desc: Beside the refused control. The reason opens the blockers in a hover card (hover, focus, or press to move into it; Escape closes). Nothing is inserted, nothing moves.
catalogue_feedback_action_error_desc: Under the field or beside the control that failed; alert role.
catalogue_feedback_notice_slot_desc: The template notice slot: one standing page state under the header. Tones info, offline, warning; null renders nothing.
catalogue_feedback_toast_desc: Off-screen outcomes, bottom trailing, announced by the polite viewport region. One follow-up action at most; pauses on hover or focus.
catalogue_status_badge_desc: Glyph plus word from the one STATUS registry. gate replaces GateLabel; profile, executable, check, write and preparation:unverified replace T4Badge.
catalogue_status_pill_desc: An inert tag (channel, band, kind): no link, no button, no hover. Tone text over its own tint.
catalogue_status_count_desc: A small number, capped at 99+, with an optional screen-reader label.
catalogue_previews_blockers_desc: Why an action is unavailable. Wrapping a focusable-disabled control, the card restates the control's description; without a control it renders the 'reason ▸' trigger of a Refusal (press moves focus into the card).
catalogue_previews_used_by_desc: 'Used by N ▸' is a link to the full list; hover or focus previews the users.
catalogue_previews_preview_desc: Preview is the L2 host the previews share; HoverCard is the L1 primitive on Base UI preview-card.
catalogue_fields_text_caption: Filled with help · empty with an error (aria-invalid, described by the message) · read-only · disabled · with an action beside the input.
catalogue_fields_choice_caption: Number with a unit · number empty with an error · select (one option disabled) · disabled select · grouped combobox, empty · segmented with a disabled option.
catalogue_fields_switch_caption: Switch on · switch disabled · folder, file (.fits, .xisf) and application modes: each opens the OS chooser; file mode empty with an error; disabled.
catalogue_fields_template_caption: Valid template with the Omit option (the filter token omitted), preview with values and with them missing · unknown token and stray brace as inline errors, no Omit option · arguments valid and with an unknown token.
catalogue_fields_settings_caption: Fields placed directly in a SettingsSection render as rows (label column, then the control); SettingsRow holds buttons, with optional help.
catalogue_shell_nav_desc: One source list for the sidebar and Settings. Current row: selected fill and aria-current. Holds: a leading bar and semibold. Menu rows open a named menu beside the list. Collapsed: an icon rail with tooltips and badge dots.
catalogue_shell_checklist_desc: Sidebar footer, above Activity and Settings. Opens a non-modal checklist to the right: the page stays usable; Escape or an outside click closes it. An unavailable step shows its reason under the label.
catalogue_shell_issue_desc: One issue with its one action and Dismiss ×. A run's next step (blocked run, calibration to review) has no ×. Dismissed rows are muted with Restore. Focus stays in the list as a row leaves.
catalogue_shell_theme_desc: Mode first (Light, Dark, Match system), then the themes of that mode. Applies at once to the whole app. The menu form goes in a toolbar menu's Theme submenu.
catalogue_shell_sidebar_recent: sidebar · recent Project open (Recent › Projects holds)
ds_color_primary: The one accent: primary action, selection, focus
ds_z_pinned_column: Pinned table column (under the sticky header row)
ds_z_flyouts: Non-modal flyouts anchored to the shell
ds_z_portalled: Portalled layers: dialogs, sheets, menus, popovers, tooltips (DOM order decides)
ds_filter_placeholder: Filter by channel, OBJECT or night
ds_empty_description: Filters change the list, not the selection. Clear them to see every session.
ds_selection_locked: Selection is locked while the View is being prepared.
ds_op_location: Location to index (indexing never changes files)
ds_op_no_locations: Register a location first; this library has none.
ds_description: Tokens and shared components in their states. Foundation-owned; tracks compose these instead of styling ad hoc.
ds_colour_description: Neutral base, one accent. Switch the theme from the header to check both.
ds_spacing: Spacing uses the Tailwind 4 px scale: control gap 2, card padding 4, page padding 6 × 5, section gap 6.
ds_row_height: Rows are --row-h, 26 px; row cells pad with --row-py. The toolbar and the batch bar are both --toolbar-h.
ds_buttons_description: Default, focus-visible (Tab to a button), active (press), disabled with a reason, loading, and toggles (pressed shows a fill and an accent bar).

match.countPlural=one: Disabled: accept or resolve {count} calibration suggestion first.
match.countPlural=*: Disabled: accept or resolve {count} calibration suggestions first.

ds_loading_vs_disabled: Loading: full opacity with a spinner and aria-busy; disabled: 50% opacity with its reason beside it.
ds_status_description: Every domain state: icon plus label, never colour alone.
ds_targets_empty_description: Targets appear when indexing finds pointing evidence. Index a capture location to begin.
ds_offline_body: {night} counts in captured integration with last-observed values. It is not offered as an available input.
ds_scan_incomplete_body: Access denied: {path}. Files there are unknown, not missing.
ds_provisional_body: Indexing is still running; totals cover {volume} captures only.
ds_save_failed: The catalog write failed. The edit is still on screen.
ds_save_stale: This Project changed since you opened it (revision {from} → {to}).
ds_table_description: Sort, select, ↑/↓ between rows. Selection is controlled by the caller and survives filtering. Groups are header rows in one table, so columns line up across groups.
ds_confirm_description: Destructive or scope-changing actions always confirm in an AlertDialog that names the scope.

match.countPlural=one: Mark {count} included frame Usable in the library?
match.countPlural=*: Mark {count} included frames Usable in the library?

ds_confirm_dialog_description: This is a library-scope quality decision.

match.countPlural=one: {count} frame becomes Usable in the library
match.countPlural=*: {count} frames become Usable in the library

simulation_ds_folder_picker_description: Simulated OS folder chooser. Volumes and folders, including empty ones, come from the simulated disk; offline volumes and denied folders show why.
simulation_this_run_description: Changes the simulated application and disk for the run on screen.
simulation_quick_actions_detail: One-click runs Restore run, Reopen run, marks on more than 20 frames, Pick the rest, and Home's Add to run, Add to Plan, Scan and Rescan where they are, with Undo where they have one. Open page sends each to the page that owns it.
simulation_run_source_drift: An outside tool rewrites a source frame
simulation_group_writes_mosaic: The application writes the assembled mosaic
ds_operation_description: Running with progress, per-item outcomes and one settled status. Uses a real indexing run.
simulation_copy_nothing: Nothing to copy: no file or folder with files at {path}.
simulation_copy_no_volume: Cannot copy to {path}: no mounted volume holds that path.
simulation_copy_read_only: Cannot copy to {path}: write permission is removed.
simulation_copy_collision: Not copied: {path} already exists. Nothing was overwritten.
simulation_volumes_description: Unmount to make a location offline. Two volumes cannot share a mount path.
simulation_folder_access_description: Deny access to make a folder unreadable at the next scan or operation.
simulation_outside_description: Changes another application or the user makes on disk.
simulation_already_copied: Already copied. Rescan to index them.
simulation_no_file_at: No file at {path}. Enter the full path of an existing file.
simulation_enter_path: Enter a folder or file path first.
simulation_overwrote: Overwrote {path} with new bytes. Restore original bytes puts them back.
simulation_nothing_to_restore: {path} has not been overwritten, so there is nothing to restore.
simulation_create_no_volume: Could not create {path}: no mounted volume holds that path.
simulation_deleted: Deleted {path} outside PlateVault. It is not in the OS Trash.
simulation_copy_enter_source: Enter the file or folder to copy in File or folder path.
simulation_copy_enter_destination: Enter the folder to copy into in Copy into folder.

match.countPlural=one: Copied {count} file byte for byte to {path}.
match.countPlural=*: Copied {count} files byte for byte to {path}.

simulation_stale_save_detail: Another writer changes the record first
simulation_fail_resolver: Fail the next Target resolver lookup
simulation_fail_resolver_detail: As if the network were unavailable
simulation_slow_index_detail: Reads 2 files at a time instead of 14, so partial results can be browsed while indexing runs
simulation_no_site_detail: Planning sees no saved site: Home Tonight, Plan and Targets show "Add an observing site in Settings"
simulation_developer_mode_on: Developer Mode turned on in Windows settings; PlateVault sees it at its next check
simulation_developer_mode_off: Symlinks need Developer Mode: Prepare refuses Symlinks, Settings › Applications and Home show the check
simulation_clock_set: PlateVault time: {time} (set by this control; kept after reload).
simulation_clock_enter: Enter a date and time first.
simulation_clock_set_to: PlateVault time set to {time}. It keeps running from there.
simulation_clock_reset: PlateVault uses the system clock again.
simulation_data_demo: Current seed: demo library. Theme, language and shortcuts are kept.
simulation_data_empty: Current seed: empty library (first run). Theme, language and shortcuts are kept.
simulation_confirm_description: This replaces all prototype data in this browser. It cannot be undone.
simulation_confirm_demo_change: Replace the catalog with the demo library ({projects})
simulation_confirm_empty_change: Remove every location, session, Project and run; onboarding starts again
simulation_sheet_description: Prototype controls. They change the simulated disk outside PlateVault; PlateVault notices on its next read.
prototype_controls_note: Simulates changes outside PlateVault for review. Not part of the product.
seed_project_cygnus_notes: Wide HOO of the North America and Pelican region; the OSC rig adds dual-band data.
seed_project_heart_notes: Ha first; OIII when the Moon allows.
catalogue_pickers_night_desc: ‹ › step a night, or a week with weekStep. The date opens a calendar: the arrow keys move a day or a week, Page Up and Page Down a month. Today stays in place, disabled on tonight. A night always has a value, so there is no empty, loading or error state.
catalogue_pickers_site_desc: Saved sites with the default marked, then Manage sites…. Without a site it is one Add site button; a site that is no longer saved reads Choose a site. The list is local, so there is no loading state.
catalogue_pickers_location_desc: The fields are the record: the marker follows them, and a map click or a marker drag writes them. Place search waits for a 1 s pause and sends at most one request per second; typing shows Searching. Use my location fills the fields or names why it could not. Offline, or when tiles or the search fail, Map unavailable replaces the map and the search.
catalogue_pickers_target_desc: Results by source: My targets, catalogues, SIMBAD. Choosing one runs its primary action and clears the input. The SIMBAD state and a missing match read under the field.
catalogue_pickers_display_desc: One named menu: radio groups, check groups (the menu stays open) and the column choice; a required column stays checked. With no group nothing renders.
catalogue_domain_plate_desc: The host owns the view, so two plates share one zoom and centre. The wheel steps the zoom at the pointer, a click at Fit zooms to 1:1 there, + and − step it from the keyboard; drag or the arrow keys pan when zoomed. Zoom, stretch and the star overlay come from the Display menu.
catalogue_domain_histogram_desc: Linear data of the region shown; the line marks the median, the sky background.
catalogue_domain_night_desc: One night at one site, in the site's time zone. The sparkline's tooltip and accessible name state the same facts.
catalogue_domain_calendar_desc: Nights ahead at a site, a week per row from the locale's first day of the week (Monday in en-GB, Sunday in pt-BR). Each night is a link wrapped in Preview: its card opens on hover and on keyboard focus, stays open while hovered, and Escape closes it. The card holds no controls, so it takes no focus. One Tab stop: the arrow keys move a night or a week, Home and End go to the week's ends. Nights before today show their date only.
catalogue_domain_calendar_filled: 30 nights from today, some suiting no goal and some with no plan
catalogue_domain_mosaic_desc: Panels north up, east left. A panel is a checkbox and takes a dragged session; a dashed slot adds a panel.
catalogue_domain_map_desc: OpenStreetMap tiles in a lazy chunk. The marker follows the fields; a click or a drag reports a position.
catalogue_domain_review_desc: Review visuals: the corner tiles, the frame thumbnails as a strip and a grid, the session plots and a star's cutouts.
catalogue_workspace_desc: The full-height body of a review step: toolbar, list, stage, inspector and status line.
flow_review_locked: Locked by a prepared run view
flow_group_no_live_panels: Every panel is in the Trash
flow_reason_reject_is_library_wide: Reject marks the frame Unusable in the library
flow_reason_whole_days: Enter a whole number of days
catalogue_stepflow_desc: One strip and one footer for every staged flow. The strip marks the current step; the footer holds the one primary action: Proceed, or the flow's own verb on the last step.
catalogue_stepflow_states_caption: Fixed flows with plain-text steps. The footer belongs to the step on screen, underlined in the strip.
catalogue_stepflow_run_caption: Steps are links, and Proceed opens the next one. Calibrate's gate holds Proceed until Auto-assign. Prepare and Finish run ask first; after Finish run every step is read-only.
catalogue_stepflow_wrapup_caption: Steps are local buttons. Proceed with nothing selected skips the step. A later step stays read-only until the ones before it are finished or skipped; an earlier step reopens until Close project.
catalogue_stepflow_review_caption: Steps are links. Finish review opens the next session that needs review; after the last one the page turns read-only.
catalogue_stepflow_dialog_caption: Steps are local buttons. Proceed opens the next step in the same dialog; only Import, on the last step, closes it. An earlier step reopens; a later one is read-only.
catalogue_templates_list_desc: A list page: one primary action, three standard ones, and the rest under the object menu. The table frame scrolls, never the page. A row opens its details beside the table from 1400 px wide, under it below that.
catalogue_templates_list_shift: Layout shift on the last selection or row change: {px} px
catalogue_templates_detail_desc: A detail page: the path, the title with its status, the object menu, view tabs and a column of boxes. A session row opens its details in the same dock as on a list page.
catalogue_templates_detail_aside_desc: A detail page with an aside: from 1280 px wide the boxes form two columns, the sections on the left and the aside on the right. Narrower, they stack in one column, the sections first.
catalogue_templates_step_desc: A step page: the step strip under the header, one step region, and the footer with Proceed fixed at the bottom. Earlier and later steps open read-only; changing step moves nothing.
catalogue_templates_step_shift: Layout shift on the last step change: {px} px
catalogue_templates_settings_desc: A Settings area: its title, setting rows, and a list section with one Add in its heading.
catalogue_feedback_save_state_desc: One settings section's save state, beside its heading: Saved after a committed write; Not saved with Retry, which runs the same write again; Changed elsewhere. Nothing before the first save.
help_tip_marks_value: P, X and U mark the frame in the library, in every Project. Reject for this Project only stays in this Project.
help_tip_auto_advance_value: P, X or U moves on to the next frame.
help_tip_pan_value: Drag or use the arrow keys. Shift pans further.
help_tip_threshold_value: Click a plot to set the threshold. Selecting frames never changes their quality.
help_tip_duplicates_value: Library locations only; capture cards are never scanned. The copy in the earliest-registered location stays.
help_tip_default_site_value: Plan and Planning use it unless you pick another. Reminders move with it.
help_tip_site_headers_value: SITELAT and SITELONG that no saved site covers.

match.countPlural=*: Moving {n} copies to the OS Trash

duplicates_none_movable: Every frame keeps a copy that can't go
calibration_master_age_help: Darks, bias and dark flats older than this read Old. Flats never age.
calibration_replace_file_help: A FITS or XISF master of the same kind.
calibration_replace_no_runs: No open run uses this master
calibration_replace_finished_keep: Finished runs keep the master they recorded.
calibration_import_folder_help: Lists the folder's FITS and XISF masters with their match.
calibration_import_no_files: No master files in this folder
calibration_no_processes_help: Import raw darks, flats or bias to start a process.
catalogue_fields_segmented_narrow: narrow box: the options wrap onto a second line inside it
catalogue_fields_notes_sample: Imaged from the back garden; flats at dusk.
catalogue_fields_group_caption: Two goals with a Remove action named after each group · a hours-or-frames error · disabled.
catalogue_fields_cell_caption: Cell mode (hideLabel): the label names the control for screen readers only; the row keeps its height.
project_all_rigs_added: every rig is in the Project
project_reopen_summary: No file moves · goal figures read the library again

match.countPlural=one: No file moves · {count} archived session stays archived
match.countPlural=*: No file moves · {count} archived sessions stay archived

trash_empty_summary: Prepared folders go to the OS Trash · Results stay
trash_empty_summary_results: Prepared folders and Results go to the OS Trash
catalogue_fields_choice_list_caption: Several picked, with help · none picked, with an error · options disabled · whole field disabled · no options (empty).
catalogue_fields_token_table_caption: A template field without its own token table, then the page's TokenTable with the Omit option.
catalogue_goal_fields_desc: C7 goal fields: each goal counts time or frames with an optional FWHM bar; the per-channel template editor.
catalogue_goal_fields_channels: limited to the rig set's channels
